verdict.rationale: Clara documents an API reference with per-resource pages, a probed OpenAPI 3.1 schema, an LLM-optimized reference, a sandbox for safe testing, and a code-examples page with complete, runnable client examples per language. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive, such as an in-browser try-it console. Postman import is an external-tool workaround and earns no credit for interactivity. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-docs request explorer/playground, runnable examples embedded directly in endpoint reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
